note: Both sets cover the same core facts and share the same serious errors: the 25,000 PSI mechanical force is misstated as 20,000 PSI, the hysteresis quote is fabricated ('change in temperature to return to full martensite' instead of 'between full austenite and full martensite'), and the '70C and 90C' commercial transition quote is truncated to 70C. Each also invents one composition figure — A 'roughly 55 percent Titanium' and B 'roughly 50 percent Nickel' — against the source's 55-65% Nickel / 44-55% Titanium. A adds two low-value claims (nickel-titanium make-up, linear actuation capability) that B omits, while B states the 25,000 PSI mechanical force correctly where A paraphrases it as 'stress'; with five flawed claims each and near-identical correct coverage, they are effectively tied.
